author: Roamingspa

title: Dont download
body: Saw someone on tiktok recommending it, was definitely an undisclosed ad. I downloaded and paid for a subscription, the app and the ai is awful and not helpful, sometimes it doesnt even understand what your saying and its response and questions make no sense. ChatGPT gives WAY better responses, all the app does is just ask questions over and over again, not even good helpful questions. So one dimensional and dont bother with it, use chatgpt instead ask it for a plan to help your adhd. Do not download or pay for this app. Have no idea why some people in the comment section on tiktok were saying it helped them i genuinely do not see how it has helped anyone. Eg. It just asks ‘why are you strugging to sleep?’ ‘what thoughts are stopping you from falling asleep?’ ‘do you have trouble winding down?’ it just goes on and on and on without ever helping or giving a plan of action. complete scam
author: SquirellTiff

title: LITERALLY LIFE CHANGING😭
body: I have sever ADHD. I saw this recommended on Tiktok by and ADHD creator and I have only been using the app for 3 days and so far it has been so so helpful for me. You can just talk to it and tell it everything you have to do at the beginning of the day and any blocks and the app helps you put things in the right order for you by time and learns what things help make you more productive vs. things to avoid. love this! Recommend

title: absolutely disgusting
body: sat through countless (scripted) tiktoks, nothing mentioning payments, and sat through the whole set up getting myself excited to finally turn my life around just to see that I have to pay a subscription. Ruined my day as i was excited to use the app (i had it downloaded for a while) to be met with the realisation that if you’re broke you get no help. Seems more like a business using people with mental health issues to make fast cash instead of actually helping us by adding the payment part at the end instead of making it clear they want money. Adhd doesn’t function the best in the capitalist world and they’ve went and capitilised the help we can get for it :(
author: Phazy2103

title: Brought here by TikTok? It’s a scam.
body:
You have come from TikTok. They were reading from a script and if you search it they are all reading from the same script. I mean word for word. You go through a big survey and they boom, £100 a year for an app. They are sponsored videos and they are not disclosing it. 
Don’t waste your time and money.
